# A unified BC Registry account type with new features and payment options

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**neeraja.kumar** (3/3/2025):

Starting March 2025, BC Registries will merge all Basic and Premium accounts into a unified account for everyone. This new account gives access to all our products .You will also get more payment options, although the specific methods available may differ by product.

**Hereâ€™s What is Changing:**

* New Account Creation Screens: The design when you create an account will be updated.
* New Product Selection Process: You will have a new way to choose the products you need.
* Payment History Access: You can view your payment statements.

**For Existing Users:**

You don't need to do anything if you already have a BC Registry account. Your account will be updated automatically.

**For New Users:**

New users will create an account using the updated process.

**Why This Change?**

We want to make it easier for you to access all our products with one account and give you more options for managing your payments.
